findings.evidenceJa: 時刻は十時前
findings.governingReading: it is before ten o’clock on a fine Sunday
findings.explanation: The precise time motivating Rin’s rush to the breakfast service disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: にやりと俺たちを見つめる遠坂の目
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka watches us with a grin, and there is something frightening in her eyes
findings.explanation: The grin and Rin’s deliberate gaze at both companions disappear, leaving only a flat judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 不屈の精神
findings.governingReading: an indomitable spirit
findings.explanation: Saber’s martial praise is weakened into an awkward description of mental persistence.

findings.evidenceJa: 店荒らしでもして
findings.governingReading: we can raid the shops
findings.explanation: Rin proposes an energetic shopping spree; the English specifically says they will only browse.

findings.highlight: She doesn’t stop even if I stop her
findings.evidenceJa: 呼び止めても止まらない
findings.governingReading: She does not stop even when I call after her
findings.explanation: The English contradicts itself by saying Rin continues after Shirou stops her.

findings.evidenceJa: 物を食べる余裕なんてない
findings.governingReading: I do not have the composure to eat anything
findings.explanation: Shirou’s nervous inability to spare attention for food becomes lack of hunger.

findings.highlight: recommends me something off the menu
findings.evidenceJa: さりげなくメニューを薦めてくる
findings.governingReading: casually recommends an item from the menu
findings.explanation: The indirect-object construction is ungrammatical and obscures Saber’s discreet attempt to taste another dessert.

findings.evidenceJa: 錬金術から発生したものだとか
findings.governingReading: is said to have arisen from alchemy
findings.explanation: Saber marks the chocolate claim as hearsay; mirror moon states it as historical fact.

findings.highlight: the payment would be too much
findings.evidenceJa: 支払いに無駄が生じる
findings.governingReading: it would make part of the expense wasteful
findings.explanation: Saber objects to waste caused by an unnecessary order, not to the price being unaffordable or excessive.

findings.highlight: for us to to experience his generosity
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちは衛宮くんの器の広さを実感する
findings.governingReading: for us to experience the breadth of his generosity
findings.explanation: A duplicated function word visibly damages Rin’s mock explanation of dating etiquette.

findings.highlight: I thoughtlessly got too close to her
findings.evidenceJa: なまじ近づきすぎてしまったから
findings.governingReading: precisely because I had grown too close to her
findings.explanation: The source identifies closeness itself as the awkward cause; the English adds a judgment that Shirou approached thoughtlessly.

findings.highlight: it’s difficult to begin normal contact this late in the game
findings.evidenceJa: 今更普通に接する事が難しかった
findings.governingReading: it had become difficult to act normally around her now
findings.explanation: A relationship problem becomes an unnatural phrase about initiating “contact,” with an unsupported game metaphor.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka laughs while walking in the park
findings.evidenceJa: 公園を歩きながら莫迦笑いをする遠坂
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: Tohsaka laughs uproariously as she walks through the park
findings.explanation: mirror moon displays a semicolon-commented narration line that is inactive in the original Japanese script.

findings.evidenceJa: お坊ちゃん風
findings.governingReading: like a sheltered young gentleman
findings.explanation: Rin’s joke about a stiff, well-bred young-master look gains an unsupported “nerdy” insult.

findings.evidenceJa: 伊達メガネ
findings.governingReading: nonprescription glasses
findings.explanation: The fact that Rin is playing with purely cosmetic glasses disappears.

findings.highlight: a pair of thick formal glasses
findings.evidenceJa: 縁の太い堅っくるしいデザインをした伊達メガネ
findings.governingReading: nonprescription glasses with thick rims and a stiffly formal design
findings.explanation: “Thick glasses” misplaces the thickness from the rims and omits that their severity is a matter of design.

findings.evidenceJa: 話半分に聞いとくよ
findings.governingReading: I’ll take it with a grain of salt
findings.explanation: Shirou says he will discount part of Rin’s claim; mirror moon says he will disregard it entirely.

findings.highlight: She fists her hand and swings it
findings.evidenceJa: 両手を合わせて、ぶん、と振る
findings.governingReading: She clasps both hands and gives them a swing
findings.explanation: A two-handed pantomime of swinging a bat becomes an ungrammatical one-handed fist action.

findings.highlight: would a girl come out and say she wants to go to such a place
findings.evidenceJa: 女の子がデートコースで、しかも自分から言いだす
findings.governingReading: would a girl choose it herself as part of a date
findings.explanation: Shirou’s assumption concerns batting as a date activity; “such a place” removes the social premise of his objection.

findings.evidenceJa: 北海の巨大アザラシ
findings.governingReading: the giant seal of the North Sea
findings.explanation: The mock attraction’s geographic epithet disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 炎の冷凍三番勝負
findings.governingReading: the flaming, freezing best-of-three showdown
findings.explanation: The absurd contrast remains, but the named best-of-three contest is reduced to one match.

findings.highlight: an integration of all your physique
findings.evidenceJa: 総合的な身体運動
findings.governingReading: a comprehensive form of physical exercise
findings.explanation: Rin’s inflated but intelligible description becomes a malformed claim about integrating Saber’s physique.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka urges me to go to the next place
findings.evidenceJa: 次に行こう、と手を伸ばしてくる遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka reaches out her hand, inviting me onward
findings.explanation: The physical offer at the center of Shirou’s reflection on enjoying the date disappears.

findings.highlight: The town I only used to walk by
findings.evidenceJa: 街の趣
findings.governingReading: the character of the town I had only ever passed through
findings.explanation: The newly perceived quality that gives the familiar city meaning is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 澱のようなモノ
findings.governingReading: something like sediment or dregs
findings.explanation: The inward residue of guilt settling through Shirou is misread as a cage falling upon him.

findings.evidenceJa: 奥でハンドル握ってた
findings.governingReading: you only played twice, then spent the rest of the time in back gripping a handle
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits Rin’s subsequent activity entirely, including the deliberately unidentified machine handle.

findings.highlight: I was only filled with spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 闘志を燃やしていただけ
findings.governingReading: I was merely burning with competitive spirit
findings.explanation: Saber’s precise denial—competitive fire rather than sulking—becomes generic spirit.

findings.highlight: My voice is heavy with sarcasm
findings.evidenceJa: 今までのお返しとばかりに皮肉を言う
findings.governingReading: I deliver the sarcasm as if repaying her for everything so far
findings.explanation: The retaliatory purpose connecting Shirou’s teasing to Rin’s earlier teasing disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m the one that gets beat
findings.evidenceJa: 全然反撃になっていなかった
findings.governingReading: it had failed completely as a counterattack
findings.explanation: A failed verbal counter is recast as Shirou being defeated, weakening the joke’s specific mechanism.

findings.evidenceJa: 食事処
findings.governingReading: place to eat
findings.explanation: The absence of any food establishment is narrowed to the absence of a café.

findings.highlight: she did hand me a bag to carry
findings.evidenceJa: 荷物持ちだとばかりに持たされたバッグ
findings.governingReading: the bag she had foisted on me as though I were her porter
findings.explanation: The comic force and Shirou’s sense of being used as a baggage carrier disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: お弁当に決まってる
findings.governingReading: It is obviously a packed lunch
findings.explanation: The concrete answer to the earlier tiered-container mystery becomes the abstract meal.

findings.evidenceJa: モシャモシャ食っちまった
findings.governingReading: you had hungrily munched your way through it
findings.explanation: The image that makes Shirou’s whole-loaf suspicion comic is omitted.

findings.highlight: There are no more worries on my chest now
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の支えも取れた
findings.governingReading: the weight has been lifted from my chest
findings.explanation: The relief idiom becomes an unnatural statement locating worries physically on his chest.

findings.highlight: There are no more worries on my chest now
findings.evidenceJa: 頷くこと二回
findings.governingReading: I nod twice
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conspicuously repeated self-satisfied nodding before noticing Rin’s expression disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 辛いの苦手だった
findings.governingReading: are you bad with spicy food
findings.explanation: Rin’s tentative question about tolerance becomes a stronger claim about dislike.

findings.evidenceJa: 手を伸ばせば触れる位置
findings.governingReading: within reach if I stretched out my hand
findings.explanation: The exact physical proximity producing Shirou’s renewed nervousness is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 服の裾
findings.governingReading: the hem of my clothes
findings.explanation: Shirou wipes his mouth with the wrong part of his clothing.

findings.evidenceJa: 不吉な赤いシミ
findings.governingReading: an ominous red stain
findings.explanation: The stain’s comic resemblance to something alarming disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 予想通りの反応
findings.governingReading: exactly the reaction I expected
findings.explanation: Rin says Shirou was predictably funny; the English gives her a prior intention to elicit that exact response.

findings.evidenceJa: 腹を押さえながらナプキンをとってよこす
findings.governingReading: holding her stomach, Tohsaka passes me a napkin
findings.explanation: The physical evidence that Rin is struggling with laughter disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 油汚れ
findings.governingReading: the oily stain
findings.explanation: The reason the sauce mark is stubborn is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 叩きのめしてあげる
findings.governingReading: I will beat you into the ground
findings.explanation: Rin threatens a thorough drubbing; “knock you out” adds the specific result of unconsciousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 返り討ちにしてやる
findings.governingReading: one day I will turn the tables and beat you
findings.explanation: Shirou’s promised reversal of Rin’s attack becomes a vague threat.

findings.evidenceJa: ばくばくとサンドイッチを平らげていく
findings.governingReading: I rapidly devour the sandwiches
findings.explanation: The speed, appetite, and completion implicit in Shirou’s retaliatory eating disappear.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka sighs with relief and reaches out for a sandwich
findings.evidenceJa: よかった、と遠坂はサンドイッチに手を伸ばした
findings.governingReading: “Thank goodness,” Tohsaka says, reaching for a sandwich
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes Rin’s spoken relief and invents a sigh instead.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーは俺の異状を知っていた
findings.governingReading: Archer knew about my abnormal condition
findings.explanation: Knowledge of a bodily problem becomes generic knowledge of Shirou’s body.

findings.evidenceJa: 何もなかったけど、ありがとう
findings.governingReading: Nothing happened, but thank you
findings.explanation: Shirou explicitly thanks Rin despite the absence of an overt incident; that concessive basis disappears.

findings.highlight: it’s not good to have your ally die
findings.evidenceJa: 協力者が減るのはマイナス
findings.governingReading: losing one of your allies would be a disadvantage
findings.explanation: A reduction in Rin’s available allies becomes Shirou’s death, adding a much more emotionally charged outcome.

findings.highlight: I kind of understand now how Tohsaka feels
findings.evidenceJa: 少しだけ遠坂の気持ちが分かったというか
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: or rather, I understood a little of how Tohsaka feels
findings.explanation: The non-Realta English branch restores a semicolon-commented Japanese inference that is inactive in the original script.

findings.highlight: It feels really great embarrassing someone you like
findings.evidenceJa: 種別は違うだろうけど
findings.governingReading: though the kind of feeling is probably different
findings.explanation: Shirou explicitly limits the parallel between his feeling and Rin’s; mirror moon omits the qualification, strengthening their equivalence.

findings.evidenceJa: 天気が怪しくなってきた
findings.governingReading: the weather begins to look threatening
findings.explanation: The approach of possible rain is reduced to unspecified change.

findings.highlight: The sky is filled with clouds
findings.evidenceJa: あれほど澄んでいた空は見る影もなく曇り
findings.governingReading: the sky that had been so clear is now clouded beyond recognition
findings.explanation: The dramatic reversal from the exceptionally clear morning sky disappears.
